prior_summary: A permutation-invariant particle encoder conditions diffusion of absolute desired container poses in the observed bowl frame; the decoder reattaches each desired source pose through the fresh observed rigid container-to-TCP transform before verified IK.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the source is securely and approximately rigidly held, bowl/container/TCP poses are reliable, the bowl may be displaced, and direct anchoring of the manipulated source through late righting is useful. The Cartesian targets must remain reachable. Use h02 for a highly ambiguous partial-discharge entry where local residual correction is preferred.
termination_guidance: Terminate or hand off only under the unchanged physical evidence: at least ten particles settled in the bowl, the source itself approximately upright and held, and outbound motion begun. Nominal return_place_release readiness is around action 1680, with supervised takeover through action 1740. Do not treat pooled particle features as a success detector.
limitations: No displaced-bowl or unusual-grasp trial was demonstrated or validated. The source-to-TCP transform must be rigid and reliably observed; slip or pose noise corrupts reattachment. Bowl displacement can make targets unreachable, and independent bowl versus return-target changes are outside demonstrated geometry. There is no spill, collision, lost-grasp or unseen-phase recovery guarantee.
